claim_reference: Adv. Funct. Mater. 2026, 36:e75639, Section 2.1, Section 2.2, Section 5, Table 1, Table S1, Table S3, Table S6 (Arithmetic & Paper Consistency)

preregistration.hypothesis: Paper numerical claims across the main text, figures, and Supplementary Information are mathematically and tabularly self-consistent.
preregistration.primary_metric: Count and severity classification of arithmetic errors, tabular contradictions, and target window violations across the 8 audited claims.
preregistration.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if 0 contradictions and 0 major discrepancies; WEAKENED if major numerical or tabular discrepancies exist; CONTRADICTED if primary headline claims are mathematically invalid.

summary: Audit of mathematical and paper consistency across 8 claims identifies 3 CONTRADICTED claims, 4 WEAKENED claims, and 1 SUPPORTED claim. Key findings include: (1) an elementary arithmetic error where the 5D grid is claimed as 6,230 formulations but equals 18,865 (3.0281x larger); (2) a critical target window violation where the main text asserts Scarred Skin relaxation of 22.5% exceeding the Table 1 maximum allowable bound (22.0%); (3) numerical conflict on Stiff Tumor modulus (16.8 kPa claimed vs 15.92 kPa in Table S3); and (4) surrogate model misrepresentation where SVR beat Gradient Boosting in SI Table S6 but was dismissed in narrative.
